purpose: qualify actual state/control/clock and boundary costs before complete nine-case D selection
old_baseline_role: immutable numerical candidate only; two-thread labels/tests are not new four-thread fitting or qualification labels
data_role: new synthetic state banks only; no formal/holdout graph PPA and no consumed primitive/Mux test labels
clock_role: exact sampled state/boundary contexts; not formal nine-case targets and not an automatic continuous SDC domain

train.packing: fourteen single-word zero-reset banks plus ten larger uniform/mixed banks with one-reset data

validation.packing: six-word banks, depth2, two enable domains, alternating resets

test.packing: seven-word banks, depth3, three enable domains, one-in-three reset pattern; locked until freeze and reproduction

source_group: whole semantic state bank plus all exact clock and stage variants; never split rows from the same source
independence: new packing/control/reset contexts at exposed word widths; not unseen widths or unlimited register-bank generalization
state_semantics: single clock; synchronous active-low reset; data enabled by actual valid-chain nodes or separate registered controls; always-advancing reset-zero control registers; logical constant padding is outside variable register storage
control_sources: training includes valid-chain enables and separate registered enables; validation/test use valid-chain enables matching native pipeline; independent publication limited to valid_chain
excluded_features: sample/source/split IDs, mapped DFF or buffer counts, measured timing/area, formal case IDs and PPA
area_label: whole mapped cell area minus separately scoped post-capture observer logic; state/control functional area and unassigned clock/physical/port repair retained separately, never charged again as arithmetic area
coefficient_rule: nonnegative train-only coefficients; compare on complete validation banks by unchanged gates, normalized MAE, serialized size and stable candidate name

boundary.H: T minus measured Q-D minus setup slack; clock/clkQ/setup/skew/uncertainty once
boundary.capture_control: maximum separately measured registered enable/data state Q-D control path
boundary.fit: freeze maximum legal train/validation H plus maximum state control delay plus existing 50ps reserve before any independent test
boundary.independent_gate: frozen input/register overheads must cover independent maximum H plus independent maximum control delay at every exact sampled target; no posterior reserve change
boundary.scope: state-bank boundaries only initially; joint arithmetic/stage boundary qualification and formal targets remain required

observer: kept hierarchy after capture, excluded from state area; every actual data/valid/control register and reset/enable behavior checked
capacity_pilots_role: registered training samples, not extra excluded probes; both must pass before remaining fitting collection
mapping_reuse: one ABC mapping per whole source at t0; other targets preserve exact netlist and rebuild SDC/ODB/physical stages
release_rule: complete fitting raw replay, validation gates, immutable parameter/domain freeze and byte-identical reproduction before new independent state tests; all mandatory independent gates before bounded publication
native_qualification: state feature extraction and actual register/reset/control binding must match the numerical schema; no arbitrary mixed-bank/native domain claim from a generated JSON alone
stage_model_decision: user confirmed separate independently qualified prices for bounded synthetic stage topologies; separate prospective protocol, existing12 untouched
